snippet.title: BoosterWare Announcemet Trailer
snippet.description:
A deckbuilding autobattler where you cheat at your favorite card game. Crack packs, build decks, and install shady tools to automate the grind. Just when you think you’ve seen everything, something new arrives. All running on an early-2000s desktop that feels a little too real.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2268510/
